items.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Oct 23 release is a heavily post-trained Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters, 1M context) that scores 55 on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index — fourth overall and within 3 points of the frontier. Full open weights are promised by Nov 4, which would make it the highest-scoring open-weight model ever.

items.name: Block Dessa
items.summary: Block (Jack Dorsey) unveiled Dessa on Oct 24, a full-duplex voice AI trained only on human speech — no text stage — that listens while speaking, laughs mid-sentence and runs locally on an M4 Max MacBook Pro. It is a research preview for AI safety researchers first, and its humanlike quality is already raising scam-call concerns.

items.name: Recursive Flint
items.summary: Recursive's Oct 21 open-weight coding model (39.8B parameters, ~2.5B active per token, Apache 2.0) is built to run locally on high-memory Apple Silicon Macs with a dedicated inference engine. It targets code investigation, bug fixes and test writing without depending on a remote inference service.

items.name: Inception Mercury 3
items.summary: Inception's Oct 19 flagship diffusion LLM claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on benchmarks while generating over 1,000 tokens per second, with a 1M-token context window. It is Inception's case that text diffusion scales to frontier quality, at launch pricing of $0.10/$0.35 per million input/output tokens.

items.name: Hi3D V1.0 (open source)
items.summary: Hi3D open-sourced its production-validated AI 3D model on Oct 23, with weights and code public and free generation on its site. Trained on 2M curated 3D assets with up to 1536³ sparse-grid reconstruction, it targets 3D printing, product design and VR/AR workflows.
